set.body: Real MNI mask probe over 97x115x97 voxels stalled in DatasetAcquisitionDomain.make before its first mask block. Owned JVM thread sample real-threads-1.txt points to requestedVoxelDomain.indices inside the reverse-map loop; indices maps the full typed vector each time, causing quadratic work/allocation. Reuse one validated index materialization for the forward injection and reverse lookup without changing identity, order or availability semantics. Verify existing domain tests and large MNI full/sparse roundtrips on JVM and JS, plus native public real-mask compilation against independent exact-index oracle. Preserve the scoped unlanded fix and captured dependency/source evidence. Probe terminated intentionally with exit 143 after diagnosis; no real support result yet. Related native spatial issue bd-01M1WCZ046GBX5JREQDJBT0G3R; consumer bd-01M1SATY405Q68RVY3N63ENVTB.
set.title: Remove quadratic voxel-index rebuilding from acquisition-domain construction
